riskRows.interaction: compare consultation choice CTAs, inspect the partitioned pre-consultation guidance, and compare the FAQ width with the main content width
riskRows.reason: Unequal supporting copy can offset paired CTAs, guidance items can lose their individual boundaries across breakpoints, a constrained FAQ can become narrower than the surrounding content, and a non-flex root can leave blank viewport space below the footer on tall displays.
riskRows.expected: The two choice CTAs share the same top and bottom coordinates at the two-column breakpoint; each pre-consultation guidance item has a distinct border-bounded cell that becomes a single-column stack on mobile; the FAQ left and right edges align with the full main content width; and the footer bottom is never above the viewport bottom when content is short.

riskRows.interaction: open mobile navigation and close with Escape
riskRows.reason: The xl navigation breakpoint and dialog focus management are easy to regress.
riskRows.expected: The drawer is visible, labelled as a dialog, traps attention, closes with Escape, and the page does not scroll horizontally.

riskRows.reason: Five-language content can overflow narrow cards and headings.
riskRows.expected: Long localized content wraps without clipping or horizontal scrolling.

riskRows.reason: Disclosure state and keyboard semantics must remain native and visible.
riskRows.expected: The first answer is visible and its summary remains keyboard operable.

riskRows.interaction: inspect and activate an instant-consultation category card
riskRows.reason: Large custom SVG cards must scale cleanly while keeping status and CTA visible.
riskRows.expected: Three distinct SVG illustrations use a consistent stroke style; cards stack at 390px and preserve visible受付中 text and a full-width video CTA.

riskRows.interaction: apply a mixed queue availability response
riskRows.reason: Each category is backed by a different queue and must update independently.
riskRows.expected: Ready categories retain an enabled video CTA while the occupied category announces 現在対応中 and disables only its own CTA.

riskRows.reason: A failed poll must not present stale availability as live.
riskRows.expected: All category actions fail closed with 状況確認中 while the client retries without exposing an error stack or credentials.

riskRows.reason: A stale or alternate action must not leak outside business hours.
riskRows.expected: Only the weekday 09:00–17:00 JST hours and closed message appear; no consultation start action is rendered.

riskRows.reason: Missing consultation connection settings must fail closed without exposing a provider name.
riskRows.expected: No start button, external tag, or fallback provider link appears.

riskRows.reason: Strict tag validation and narrow admin layout can regress together.
